Findings.problem: The ledger is now freely assignable ghost data, so a caller can mint an obligation, keep the tracked token, and reset frame_obligations to Multiset::empty(). inv() does not constrain this field, so clean_inv() then reports a clean boundary while the token remains outstanding.
Findings.key_premise: After tracked_mint_frame_obligation, the public ghost field can be reset without consuming its returned DropObligation; clean_inv checks only inv plus ledger emptiness.
Findings.suggestion: Represent conservation with an authoritative tracked resource linked to obligation tokens, and expose only mint/redeem operations preserving that relationship. Merely hiding the field is insufficient without the token-to-ledger invariant.
